subject: Tufts Student Housing and Green Score Zoning
overview: The Board approved the 401 Boston Avenue site plan under the Dover Amendment with specific conditions for community transparency and accountability. They also recommended the adoption of the Green Score Zoning Amendment to the City Council to improve ecological standards for private development.

items.title: 401 Boston Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Approved the site plan for a student housing project at 401 Boston Avenue under the Dover Amendment despite significant community dissatisfaction. To address neighborhood impacts, the Board added requirements for annual reporting on shuttle usage and police calls, as well as transparency mandates for a university-funded neighborhood improvement fund.

items.title: Bridal Path Definitive Subdivision
items.summary: Approved the definitive subdivision for Bridal Path subject to updated conditions including a prohibition on blasting without further board approval and the submission of a construction management plan.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Zoning Amendment Continuation
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for the Salem Street Corridor zoning amendment to March 5 and announced a public Q&A session scheduled for February 10 at Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: Green Score Zoning Amendment Recommendation
items.summary: Voted to recommend that the City Council approve the Green Score Zoning Amendment (Paper 24-499), a multiplier-based ecological performance system for new developments. The recommendation includes refined definitions for green and blue roofs and scoring flexibility for affordable housing projects.

items.title: Minutes and Zoning Updates
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes for November 2024, December 2024, and January 2025 and received brief updates on zoning outreach efforts.
